en: Instead, Elsin did the unexpected. He built an entirely new city on the southern shore of Lake Efnian -- Kaluen. A glorious capitol was constructed, with monuments and parks to rival even the ancient works of the Kandra. All things good and true flow from Aramon to Elsin's city-by-the-lake; the people enjoy the finest goods and foodstuffs carted in each day to be sold in the many markets. Kaluen is truly the marvel of all Aramon.
zh: 相反，艾尔辛做了出人意料的事。他在艾夫尼亚湖的南岸建立了一座全新的城市——卡鲁恩。一座辉煌的首都被建造起来，其纪念碑和公园甚至可与古凯兰德人的作品相媲美。所有美好的事物都从阿拉蒙流向艾尔辛的湖畔之城；市民们每天都能享受到从各地运来的最优质商品和美食在众多市场中出售。卡鲁恩确实是阿拉蒙的奇迹。

en: Narmer is perhaps the most cultured of Aramon's major cities, perhaps reflecting the influence of the powerful House of Dernhest. Sages and mages of many different outlooks often gather in the common rooms of Narmer inns, and discussion of Aramon and its place among the Four Realms is often the norm. A sense of closeness exists among the people of Narmer and their cousins across the lake in Kaluen, and marriages between the two cities' merchant families and nobility is not uncommon.
zh: Narmer或许是阿拉蒙最文化的城市之一，或许反映了强大德恩赫斯特家族的影响。来自不同立场的智者与法师常聚集在Narmer酒馆的公共房间，讨论阿拉蒙在四大领域中的地位是常态。Narmer居民与湖对岸Kaluen的表亲之间存在着亲近感，两城商人与贵族之间的联姻也屡见不鲜。
ctx: 游戏内嵌网页正文段落

en: The White City takes it names from the white stone that is the backbone of the city's buildings and fortifications, each a thing quite pleasing to the eye. Ralum is home to families of extraordinary stonemasons, and their work is truly a thing to behold. Their skills handed down from parent to child over many generations, the masons of Ralum raised high the mighty walls of Kaluen, and perhaps saved their best work for their own city by the water.
zh: 白色之城的名字来源于支撑城市建筑与防御工事的白色石料，每座建筑都令人赏心悦目。Ralum是卓越石匠家族的故乡，他们的作品堪称一绝。历经多代传承的技艺，Ralum的石匠们建造了Kaluen的高墙，或许将最精美的作品留给了自己城邦——那座临水而建的城市。

en: Our journey's end came days later, with our leader's triumphant return home to the piers and streets of Lendra. The return was marred by the fact that Captain Lahar at first simply refused to relinquish the ship's wheel to Horvino, who wished to demonstrate his newly won prowess as a sailor and navigator. Lahar claimed that the shifting winds at this time of year made the passage into the bay somewhat difficult, and with the possibility of reefs or sandbars below, perhaps dangerous, as well.
zh: 数日后，我们的旅程终章到来，领袖凯旋返回伦德拉的码头与街道。然而返程却因拉哈尔船长最初拒绝将船舵交予霍尔文诺而蒙上阴影，后者希望展示自己新获得的航海与导航技艺。拉哈尔声称，每年此时的风向变化使进入海湾的航程颇为艰难，加之下方可能有暗礁或沙洲，或许相当危险。

en: But the Hand ... Takkawaw's Hand calls me. The map feels hot and heavy in my satchel - I have committed it to memory, lines burned in my head. The tribal elder, Uary, has offered me escort through the southern Tethrian. Promised me escort to foot of the Haemus Mountains and the trailhead that leads to Ulasem. It's a trail they use for pilgrimages to honor Thirsha's throne in Ulasem.
zh: 但是……塔卡瓦瓦（Takkawaw）的手正在召唤我。那张地图在我的背包里显得异常沉重；我已经将它的路线牢记在心，相关信息早已深深地刻在我的脑海中。部落的长者乌阿里（Uary）答应护送我穿越泰斯里安（Tethrian）南部地区，并将我送到海姆斯山脉（Haemus Mountains）的脚下，以及通往乌拉塞姆（Ulasem）的路径起点。这条路线是他们每年用来朝圣、向乌拉塞姆的瑟莎王座（Thirsha’s Throne）表达敬意的通道。

en: A Verunan merchant vessel had put in to the city for fresh water before heading to Khusra in the south. I called out to the vessel's captain in Lihr's Tongue and shared the story of my predicament. The captain, a man named Moar, took me aboard in exchange for work and I happily set about with the running of lines and scraping of barnacles. Huh. Every Verunan boy is taught ship-skills - I am no different. Only to Khusra, the captain said. Only closer to Ulasem, said I. Closer to the prize. The Hand. The Hand!
zh: 一艘维鲁纳商船曾停靠此城获取淡水，然后前往南方的库希拉。我用里尔语向船长呼救，并讲述了我的困境。船长名叫莫尔，他收留了我，作为交换我愿意工作，高兴地参与了清理缆绳和船底藤壶的工作。哼，每个维鲁纳男孩都会学习航海技能——我也不例外。只前往库希拉，船长说。只更接近乌拉塞姆，我说。更接近奖赏。塔卡瓦瓦之手。塔卡瓦瓦之手！

en: Unfortunately, my master was unable to secure transport to the other Southern Islands - Varro, Greif, Altus and Ettan, the ancestral homes of the Berserkers, those fearsome men of many a Verunan legend. Our leader was kept from these islands partly due to inclement weather and a few unruly ship captains who refused to meet Horvino's traveling requirements. Although merely a scribe, I fail to see how our leader's group of personal minstrels could do anything but help make the journey a joyful one.

en: Athri is quite different in flavor than Caora (indeed, each of the Three Sisters has its own distinctiveness), being heavily forested with fragrant trees of reddish wood. Whereas Vanoc folk remain close to the sea (and therefore "rural," in their own sense), the people of Athri are as cultured and noble as the Lendran folk. The Athri-folk also enjoy a large amount of trade with unnamed lands to the far north; local merchants offer for sale furs from strange beasts, colorful fabrics and weapons of iron and other fine alloys than are not easily found in Darien.
zh: 阿斯里与卡奥拉截然不同（事实上，三姐妹各自都有独特的风味），这里遍布着香气四溢的红木树。而范诺克人则紧邻海洋（因此在他们自己的观念中是“农村的”），阿斯里人则如同伦德兰人一般，同样拥有高雅的文化与贵族气质。阿斯里人还与北方无名之地进行大量贸易；当地商人出售奇异野兽的皮毛、多彩织物以及铁制武器和其他优质合金制品，这些物品在达里恩并不容易获得。

en: Vanir's Breach: The ship's navigator, a woman named Anemone, related a Vidaran legend concerning the Vanir sea. Anemone said that long ago, before the rule of the Kandra, the nations we call Aramon and Zhon were actually parts of a single land, with one people, the Vanir, living there in peace. And in a fit of rage, the god of these people split the land asunder, and the waters rushed in to fill the emptiness.
zh: Vanir的裂隙：船上的导航员，一位名叫阿内蒙的女性，讲述了一个关于Vanir海的维达兰传说。阿内蒙说，很久以前，在坎德拉统治之前，我们称之为阿拉蒙和佐恩的国家其实是同一片土地的一部分，那里的人民，即Vanir，和平生活。而由于愤怒，这位神明将土地撕裂，海水涌入填补空缺。

en: Even our captors, the Executioner guardsmen, were visibly frightened, and we were hurriedly ushered into a stable. There we were held without food for three days; all we had were each other to cling to, which was cold comfort indeed from the chaos and suffering outside. It was as if we were trapped within the gates of Hell.
zh: 甚至我们的俘虏者——行刑者卫兵——也明显感到恐惧，我们被匆忙带进了一个马厩。在那里，我们三天没有食物；我们唯一能依靠的就是彼此，这从外界的混乱和苦难中确实难以得到一丝安慰。仿佛我们被困在了地狱之门内。

en: Meredoc's beauty soon overwhelmed the party, pushing the troublesome time aboard ship out of our minds. Rumored to have been settled by a Kandran wizard of particular might, Meredoc is the largest settlement in the southern islands, sitting astride the major trade route to Aramon. As the closest Verunan settlement to the western lands, it can be said that the people of this island are more like Aramon folk than Verunan. Meredoc's people are a rustic, florid folk, and speak the Verunan tongue with a distinctive, guttural accent. They are also quite religious, likely the result of influence by the noble house of Jatha, which is known for its piety. The worship of both Lihr and Anu, and other lesser gods, is practiced openly.
zh: 梅雷多克的美景很快让众人忘却了船上的烦扰。据说这里曾由一位特别强大的坎德兰法师建立，是南方群岛最大的聚居地，坐落于通往阿拉蒙的主要贸易航线上。作为距离西方大陆最近的维鲁纳聚居地，可以说岛上的居民更像阿拉蒙人而非维鲁纳人。梅雷多克的居民是一群朴实而热情的人，他们用带有独特喉音的维鲁纳语交谈。他们也相当虔诚，这可能源于贾塔贵族家族的影响，该家族以虔诚著称。公开崇拜里尔和安努以及其他较小的神明在这里是常见的。

en: An interesting note from this region is the Dengland ruins, a series of apparently man-made structures that lie on sandy islands in the river south of Abiad. Perhaps constructed by an earlier people during the Shadowtime, the Dengland ruins are completely covered by the rising Chasul waters in the spring and summer months, and only emerge in fall and winter. It is not known if the ruins were constructed before the river found its present course, or if they are the result of some strange magic. Either way, erosion from the waters and the limited time the ruins are exposed to the light of day hampers any large-scale study.
zh: 这个地区的一个有趣注记是登格兰遗迹，这是一系列显然为人工建造的结构，位于阿比亚以南河流中的沙岛上。或许是在阴影时代由早期文明建造的，登格兰遗迹在春夏季会被上升的查苏尔河水完全覆盖，仅在秋季和冬季显现。尚不清楚这些遗迹是否是在河流形成当前河道之前建造的，还是某种奇异魔法的结果。无论如何，水流的侵蚀作用以及遗迹暴露在日光下的有限时间都会阻碍大规模研究。

en: In the second year of the Baron's rule, my family joined a small party of neighbors who wished to escape the Leimar lands and crawl out from under the Baron's mailed fist. Our goal was the city of Shekelesh, which lay just to the north at the foot of the Greater Kaf. Father hoped to find work in the tanning of leather; his brother, my uncle, had ventured north three years earlier. In his last letter, my uncle said he was able to build a small home just outside the city walls. Shekelesh, and family. It would be safe.

en: It's going to matter tremendously, no matter what level of prestige you've earned in the Darien Crusades. en: The geographers of Aramon can never agree on precisely where the inlet ends and the mighty Humber River begins. One theory, held by the geographers of Ralum, is that any expanse of water which can be easily swam by a man of average condition is a river. Anything wider is a lake, bay or inlet. The Royal cartographers of Kaluen differ in their definition -- they maintain that it is the length of the waterway, combined with the character of its currents, that ultimately determines its classification.
zh: 阿拉蒙的地理学家们始终无法就入海口究竟在哪里结束、亨伯河又从何处开始达成一致。拉鲁姆的地理学家们持有一种理论，认为只要是一般人能够轻松游过的水域就是河流。任何更宽广的则被归类为湖泊、海湾或入海口。卡鲁恩的皇家制图师们则持不同观点——他们坚持认为，水道的长度及其水流特性才是决定其分类的最终因素。

en: Mt. Pharidon is one of the most recognizable landmarks in Aramon, a conical, snow-capped mountain emerging from the surrounding foothills. The mountain can been seen for scores of miles in either direction, serving as a beacon for travelers to the western cities of Waleph and Gwillion. It has not been determined if Pharidon is actually a dormant volcano, although bursts of steam are seen to escape from the summit. Some learned men insist the mountain is actually a relic of Kandran magic, perhaps a giant lodestone.

en: My master spent many days wandering Wyldon's narrow alleys, partaking in fine wines and spirited debate in the city's many sidewalk cafes. With Horvino's tendency toward bombastic speech, I am sure my master made an impression on the local scholars who often gathered in Wyldon's cafes. On one occasion, I witnessed my master hurriedly escorted from within a cafe by two burly scullery boys, while much laughter spilled into the street. Horvino said it was merely a misunderstanding over a game of dice.
zh: 我的主人在Wyldon狭窄的小巷中徘徊了许多天，在城市的众多街头咖啡馆品尝美酒并参与热烈辩论。考虑到霍尔维诺爱说夸张的话，我确信我的主人给当地学者们留下了深刻印象。有一次，我目睹我的主人被两个粗壮的洗碗男孩匆忙从咖啡馆内护送出去，而许多笑声洒满了街道。霍尔维诺说这只是对一场掷骰子游戏的误会。

en: Your grandmother was born in Ugarit, on the southeast shores of Taros, between the southern Kaf Mountains and the Namtar River. I swam in the Namtar -- I did! -- as a girl. Ugarit was near where Garacaius himself lived as a boy. He was a fisherman, just like the men of my family. The waters off the Great Delta were long ago rich with fish and crab. The green grass of the Delta islands, the mountains, the forest to the south -- it was all quite beautiful and temperate, not unlike fair Aramon is today.
zh: 你的祖母出生在塔罗斯东南海岸的乌加里特，位于南部卡夫山脉与纳姆塔河之间。我小时候曾在纳姆塔河游泳——我确实做过！——乌加里特是加拉凯乌斯小时候居住的地方。他是个渔夫，和我家族的男人们一样。很久以前，大三角洲的水域盛产鱼和蟹。三角洲岛屿的青草、山脉、南方的森林——一切都相当美丽宜人，不亚于如今的阿拉蒙。

en: There were no people to speak of, for Elam was a city of the dead. We passed columns of skeleton soldiers walking clickety-clack in crisp formation. Herds of dead men, their flesh still attached, wandered the alleys. Above, there were reptilian Gargoyles, either flying on leather wings or sitting stone silent on castle walls. Ghost Ships hovered over Lake Dagon, and I saw a demon, I did -- a brick-red monstrosity that carried a wicked blade. I shudder at that memory.
zh: 几乎看不到活人，因为艾尔辛是一座死城。我们经过一列列整齐列队的骷髅士兵，他们咔嗒咔嗒地行走着。成群的尸体，皮肉尚在，游荡在巷弄间。上方，有鳞片状的石像鬼，有的在皮革翅膀上飞翔，有的则静默地坐在城堡墙壁上。幽灵船在达贡湖上空盘旋，我确实看到了一个恶魔——一只砖红色的怪物，挥舞着一把邪恶的利刃。我至今仍对此记忆犹新，不寒而栗。

en: The Thunor are often called the "Blue Hills" because of their appearance in a hazy evening. The mountains themselves appear older, less spare and rocky, than their counterparts elsewhere. Time has softened their edges, and a great many colorful trees have taken residence among the peaks. Wildlife abounds -- it is said that the Thunor is a place with a profound quantity of birds, bears and elbow room. Many well-worn trails are carved into the northern passes, allowing caravans to wend their way from Abiad to Kaleun each month.
zh: Thunor 通常被称为『蓝色山脉』，因为它们在黄昏时显得朦胧。这些山脉本身看起来更古老，更少岩石，与其他地方的山脉相比。时间已经让它们的边缘变得柔和，许多色彩斑斓的树木在山峰间安家。野生动物繁盛——据说 Thunor 是一个鸟类、熊和宽敞空间丰富的地区。许多磨损的路径被雕刻在北方的山口，允许商队每月从 Abiad 到 Kaleun 蜿蜒前行。

en: Many geographers maintain that the Yniol wood is, in fact, four or five separate forests, and this is borne out by the variance of foliage in different parts of the forest. Southward near the edge of the Frontier, evergreens such as fir and blue spruce return to view.

en: This dispute was put to the test in the latter half of the reign of Garacaius. Two representatives, Winfrey of Ralum and Dagnir of Kaluen, met 40 leagues north of Laingen to prove their respective theories. Winfrey intended to swim across the Humber. Dagnir planned to merely float in the hopes of demonstrating that the current of the Humber was still more powerful than the tides. Unfortunately, neither scholar was aware of the strong current caused by the spring thaw in the flatlands below Ullin's Fingers. Both were swept out to the Sea of Mannan, never to be seen again. The result of this experiment was inconclusive.
zh: 这场争论在加拉西亚斯统治的后半段接受了考验。两位代表——拉鲁姆的温弗莱和卡鲁恩的达格尼尔——在莱因根以北40里格处会面，以证明各自的理论。温弗莱打算横渡亨伯河。达格尼尔则计划仅漂浮以证明亨伯河的水流仍比潮汐更强大。不幸的是，两位学者都未意识到乌林手指下方平原春季融雪引发的强大洋流。他们都被卷入曼南海，从此杳无音讯。这次实验的结果不明确。

en: The Sea of Tapas: "If ye can make it past the Geryon, the Tapas awaits you," said Captain Lahar. "And then you be surely doomed." First officer Sculpin said at night, the Tapas was black as coal, with no stars in the night sky to guide you. He said other sailors had reported that bands of Tarosian tribesmen lit false signal fires on the shoreline, leading ships to founder on sharp reefs. Other sailors told tales of meeting a tribe called the Kiniket who made their home on the northeastern shores of Zhon. The Kiniket, they said, provided the only safe haven in these parts, a peaceful place of warm, verdant beaches.
zh: 塔帕斯海：‘若你能越过杰里昂，塔帕斯将等待你，’拉哈尔船长说道。‘然后你将注定灭亡。’第一副官斯库平说，夜晚的塔帕斯如同煤块般漆黑，夜空中没有星星指引方向。他提到其他水手报告称，塔罗斯部落的战士们在岸边点燃虚假的信号火，导致船只撞上尖锐的礁石沉没。其他水手则讲述了遇见一个名为基尼克特的部落的经历，该部落居住在佐恩东北海岸。他们说，基尼克特是这片区域唯一的安全避风港，一个温暖、绿意盎然的和平之地。

en: Now, the nights had always been different, as the walls of the great city were closed, and horror befell those locked outside. "Never go out at night!" I can hear Mother insisting even now. But slowly, not all at once, it seemed Ugarit slipped gradually into the sewer ditches. Grandmother Eder remembers the night-wolf howling outside the city walls growing louder in the summer. I remember the coronation of Baron Leimar, as well as the first executions of those who spoke out against he and his clan. I remember skies the color of fireplace ashes. I remember voices talking from the sewers, beckoning. I remember men marching from the Academy, never to be seen again by their families.
zh: 现在，夜晚一直与白日不同，因为大城的城墙会关闭，那些被锁在外面的人便会遭遇恐怖。我甚至现在还能听到母亲坚持说：‘千万别在夜里外出！’但渐渐地，而不是突然之间，乌加里特似乎慢慢滑入了下水道沟壑。祖母艾德记得夏天里城墙外的夜狼嚎叫声越来越响。我记得男爵利玛尔的加冕礼，也记得那些反对他及其氏族的人首次被处决。我记得天空如同壁炉灰烬般灰暗。我记得有人从下水道沟壑中说话，召唤着我们。我记得人们从学院出发行军，从此再也没有被家人看到。

Angvir, and where the lava meets the water, a great quantity of steam is produced. As a bosun's mate in earlier days, Lahar's ship put in at northern cove to take on a horrible cargo: slaves captured in Taros' inner lands. "Rough trade, that," said Lahar. "Not for me. I jumped ship as soon as we returned to Veruna."
zh: 迷雾湾：并非迷雾，而是蒸汽，赋予了这片水域其名称，拉哈尔船长说道。一条血红色的熔岩河流从安格维山的山坡向西流淌，当熔岩与海水相遇时，会产生大量蒸汽。在过去的年代里，作为大副的拉哈尔曾将船停泊在北方海湾，装载着可怕的货物：从塔罗斯内陆捕获的奴隶。‘这就是粗暴的贸易，’拉哈尔说道。‘不关我的事。我们一回到维鲁纳，我就弃船而去了。’

en: A player can hold a ranked status in all four sides; however, players hold an active rank (and rank icon) for only one race at any time, so choose well whom you will serve. An Aramon player with a high ranking who switches to playing as Zhon will maintain their Aramon rank only until they are promoted to an equal rank in Zhon. In order to regain their Aramon icon as the active icon, they must meet the conditions of promotion to a higher Aramon ranking than the last achieved Aramon ranking they obtained before converting to a different race. Needless to say, the higher your ranking upon departure from fealty to a particular nation, the harder it becomes to regain the confidence and trust of that nation upon your return.

en: The journal consists of 42 leaves of a stiff, scroll-like material that is unknown among the Verunan islands. Most of the leaves are covered on both sides with intelligible letters of black ink that correspond to the characters of the High Speech. The leaves themselves, colored a dull yellow, seem to be composed of some kind of vegetable fiber. They are as thin as scroll-paper, but they are quite durable and shed water like a duck's feathers. While the tale they contain is certainly astonishing, it is this monk's humble wish that the Order of Letters could locate the creators of the leaves, as the material would be invaluable to our work.
zh: 这本日记由42页硬质的卷轴状材料制成，这种材料在维鲁纳群岛中并不为人所知。这些页片的正反面都覆盖着可辨识的黑色墨水字母，与高等语言的字符相对应。这些页片呈暗黄色，似乎由某种植物纤维制成。它们的厚度与卷轴纸相当，但非常耐用，能像鸭子羽毛一样防水。虽然其中的故事确实令人惊讶，但这位僧侣只是谦卑地希望文字之秩序能找到这些页片的创造者，因为这种材料对我们的工作将非常宝贵。

en: The Kandra is a forest primarily of oak and yew, a happy coincidence for the Guilds of Fletchers and Bowyers, who turn Kandran wood into the finest weapons in the land. The ocean breezes and fine soil combine in just the right way to produce yew that is strong, yet flexible, for long bows. The oak branches are quite dense, perfect for straight and sturdy arrows. Kandra Forest arrows are easily recognizable from their blue fletching, and it is said that each will find 10 targets in its lifetime.
zh: 坎德拉森林主要由橡树和胡桃树组成，这对弓箭手和弓箭制造者的行会来说是个幸运的巧合，他们将坎德拉木材制成大陆上最精良的武器。海洋的微风与肥沃的土壤完美结合，产出的胡桃树材质地坚韧却富有弹性，非常适合制作长弓。橡树的枝干非常密集，正适合制造笔直而坚固的箭矢。坎德拉森林的箭矢因其蓝色的羽饰而极易辨认，据说每支箭一生能击中10个目标。

en: At the start of the first crusade, the western portion of Darien remains under control of the Order of Honor, while the eastern portion seethes in the clutches of the Council of Terror. Between them lie contested territories ripe for invasion. It is upon these volatile territories that players wage war. Each of the 313 territories across Darien has associated with it a particular Kingdoms map for players to compete on, with pre-assigned map restrictions and game launch parameters. Once one side or the other exceeds the victory conditions for ownership (described below), that territory falls under the control of the victorious side. At the same time, neighboring regions weakened by the shift in power find their lands suddenly contested by the warring armies.

My master loudly shared with them stories of his own hunting skills and of dangerous excursions where he was protected only by a small group of his father's armed guards.

en: The dark, forbidding Lern has also sparked many a tale of faeries and dryads, including a well-spoken tale of "Merryandrew," a clownish imp that protects lost children and makes fools of burly lumberjacks. Similar tales are also told among woodsmen of the Vast Yniol Forest. Whether Merryandrew is some creature of magic or just a mother's story is unknown.
zh: 阴暗可怕的勒恩也激发了许多关于精灵和树精的传说，包括一个广为流传的故事："梅瑞安德鲁"，一个逗笑的精灵，保护迷路的孩子并戏弄强壮的伐木工。类似的传说也在广袤的伊尼尔森林的伐木人中流传。梅瑞安德鲁是某种魔法生物，还是仅仅母亲的故事，无人知晓。

en: However, from conversations in Meredoc's few inns, I learned in earlier times, the islands of Varro and Grief were once ruled by the nation of Aramon, and the Verunan navy has sailed more than a few times in support of the Berserker tribes to turn back the southern folk. These days, the islands populated mainly by common folk who make their living as fishermen and goatherders. It was probably for the better, as it seem highly unlikely we could have found an inn suitable for Horvino's delicate slumber, or a public house that serves the finest cuts of spiced beef.
zh: 然而，从梅雷多克少数酒馆的交谈中，我得知在更早的年代，瓦洛和哀伤群岛曾由阿拉蒙国统治，维鲁纳海军曾多次支援狂战士部落，击退南方百姓。如今，这些岛屿主要居住着以捕鱼和养山羊为生的普通百姓。这或许更好，因为似乎很难找到适合霍尔维诺细致睡眠的酒馆，或提供最上等香料牛排的公共酒馆。

en: Our fair kingdom is both the most sizable and prosperous of the Four Realms. It is a land of green fields, crystalline lakes and magnificent mountains. From the Kuvera Straits to the Edamothi Sea, Aramon is unparalleled in natural beauty, and in the industry of its people. The people of Aramon are noteworthy for their ingenuity and skill at many trades. While they may lack the social graces and refinement of the worldly Verunans, they are friendly, outgoing and generous.
zh: 我们公正的王国是四大领域中最大且最繁荣的。这里绿田广袤，湖泊清澈，山峦壮丽。从库维拉海峡到埃达莫西海，阿拉蒙在自然美景和人民的产业方面都是无与伦比的。阿拉蒙的人民以其在多种工艺上的创造力和技艺而著称。尽管他们可能缺乏维鲁纳人那种世俗的社交礼仪和优雅，但他们友善、外向且慷慨。

en: The Sea of Mokanna: Only the ship's first officer, a man named Sculpin, had been to these northeastern waters. Sculpin said he would not do so again, "no, not again in this life." By day, said Sculpin, the ship was followed by sharks, some longer than the ship's mast is tall, he said, and daring enough to bump the vessel itself. At night, ghostly lights would flit this way and that, and the crew could see many bonfires in the hills of Taros.
zh: 莫卡纳海：只有船上的大副斯库尔品去过这些东北部水域。斯库尔品说他不会再去了，"不，这辈子不会再来了。" 他说白天船会被鲨鱼跟随，有些鲨鱼比船桅杆还要长，甚至大胆到撞船。夜晚，幽灵般的灯光四处游移，船员们能看到塔罗斯山丘上的许多篝火。

en: The Winner Takes All Ladder is quite similar in scope to the Duel Ladder. Tactics change drastically when a full assault against one opponent may leave you exposed to attack on other fronts.

We were hungry much of the time, for few edible plants, animals or people lived here -- just the numerous insects that seemed to flourish in the boiling pools.

en: Of my father's brother, we saw not; Shekelesh itself had been ripped asunder by the madness of the Belial-worshippers. The men of the party furiously debated what to do. Some blamed Father for leading them north -- surely Ugarit was not as bad as this damned place, they said. Others wanted to drive east to the water and perhaps bargain for passage to the islands of Zakum and Siddhi. Zakum was rumored to be settled by those friendly to those escaping Taros, but Father said that could not be so, for it was not long ago that Baron Leimar had routed the Zakum people in a bloody conflict.
zh: 我们并未见到我父亲的兄弟；谢克勒什本身已被贝尔耶尔崇拜者的疯狂撕裂。队伍中的成员激烈争论该做什么。有人指责父亲带他们向北走——他们说乌加里特显然没有这里这么糟糕。另一些人则想向东前往水域，或许能与扎库姆和西地岛的居民交易。据说扎库姆住着那些友善于逃离塔罗斯的人，但父亲说这不可能，因为不久之前，莱玛尔男爵就在一场血腥的战斗中击败了扎库姆人。

en: But I was frightened then, for the guards were Taros Executioners, with their long pole-blades that went snickety-snak. Cut you to pieces they would. But the Dark Priest that commanded them had a need for servants, and he singled out my family and some others. Soon I found myself within the castle walls, carrying jugs of wine and frothy beer to the Priest's table as he conferred with the nobles of Shekelesh. Can you imagine me, dressed in rags with a dirty, smudged face, while the noblemen and magicians tore apart hunks of pork and fowl and wiped their greasy fingers on long, dark tables of fine wood.
zh: 但那时我感到害怕，因为守卫是塔罗斯行刑者，他们手持长柄刺刀，发出咔嗒咔嗒的声音。他们能把人切成碎片。但指挥他们的黑暗祭司需要仆人，他特别选中了我的家人和其他一些人。很快我就发现自己身处城堡之内，提着酒壶和泡沫啤酒为祭司的餐桌服务，而他正与舍凯勒斯的贵族们商议。你能想象我吗？穿着破烂的衣服，脸上脏兮兮的，而贵族们和魔法师们则撕扯着猪肉和禽类，用长而黑暗的优质木桌擦去油腻的手指。

en: All was not lost for us. For in the chaos of the moment, we entered the city unchallenged. Quilp was not unlike Ugarit, a city of merchants and smiths, all of them speaking the Taros tongue. The first night we spent wandering, but Father soon found bedding in an empty stable, and later found work unloading ships on the nearby docks. And when the Verunans arrived to trade, we traveled with them to Lendra and then to Aramon.

But the smell stays on your clothes, and in your hair, too.

en: It is an apt description, as the Humber starts as a swift-flowing creek at the foot of Mt. Pharidon, colored milky white by glacial silt. The silt settles and the water grows clear, gaining strength at the meeting of the Frey River. The Humber and Upper Humber provide water for a great many fields and pasturelands in and around the Kingsbarrow. As it nears the Inlet, the Humber finally loses its strength and flows gently toward the ocean.
zh: 这描述恰如其分，因为亨伯河起源于法里顿山脚下的急流小溪，因冰川淤泥而呈现乳白色。淤泥沉淀后，河水变得清澈，并在与弗莱河交汇处获得力量。亨伯河和上亨伯河为金斯巴罗周边的众多农田和牧场提供水源。当它接近入海口时，亨伯河最终失去力量，缓缓流向大海。

en: Edamothi Sea: Captain Lahar said the southernmost of Darien's seas turned perfectly clear in the eastern reaches, so much so that one could see bright coral reefs passing beneath ships. Other travelers, Lahar said, spoke of finding civilized lands farther south, populated by a strange folk who erect great stone temples to their many gods.

en: While the Near-Men of northern Zhon were dirty and foul, the Kiniket were gentle, curious and kind. Pelts of straw, eyes of deep brown. They spoke the Zhon tongue with a lilting accent. Plied me with food, they did. Fruits and fishes, and a fine drink brewed of a grain they called sorat. Spent a fortnight among them; the Kiniket children seemed to especially like me for my beard, black hair and leather clothes.
zh: 北方佐恩的近人肮脏污秽，而基尼凯特人则温顺好奇且善良。他们用稻草做皮，深褐色的眼睛。他们用带有抑扬顿挫语调的佐恩语交谈。他们热情地款待我，给我水果、鱼类，以及用他们称为sorat的谷物酿造的美酒。我在他们中间度过了两周；基尼凯特的孩子们似乎特别喜欢我的胡须、黑发和皮衣。

en: Borne along on horse carts (thankfully the roads were level and well-maintained), our glorious leader traveled westward through the hills known as Lihr's Children. This land is truly a sight -- the hills are ringed with stone terraces in which the local populace farms rice and other grains. As their home is named after the God of the Waves, so do the people consider themselves equally blessed.
zh: 我们伟大的领袖乘坐马车向西穿越被称为里尔之子的山丘（幸运的是道路平坦且维护良好）。这片土地真是风景如画——山丘环绕着石砌梯田，当地居民在此种植稻米和其他谷物。正如他们的家园以海神之名命名，人们也认为自己同样蒙受恩赐。

en: The road ran along the foothills of the Lesser Kaf; Father told me these mountains were once called the Spine of Taros, for they near split the land in twain from north to south. It was the farthest I had ever been from Ugarit, and soon enough I could see evidence of the Necromancer's passing, for Lokken's magic had twisted and broken the very land itself. The smell of magic hung in the air; trees were bent and broken, oozing yellow pus. Cawing black birds abounded, each large enough to attack the horses. Farmers' fields were overtaken with biting, stinging insects, the likes of which no one had ever seen before.
zh: 道路沿着小卡夫山麓延伸；父亲告诉我，这些山曾被称为“塔罗斯之脊”，因为它们几乎把大地从北到南一分为二。那是我离乌加里特最远的一次；很快我就看到了死灵法师经过的痕迹——洛肯的魔法扭曲并撕裂了大地本身。空气中弥漫着魔法的气味；树木弯折断裂，渗出黄色的脓液。呱呱叫的黑色鸟群到处都是，每一只都大得足以攻击马匹。农民的田地被咬人蜇人的昆虫占据，那种虫子谁也没见过。

en: Against this bucolic backdrop, an ancient tradition is observed. Since the first days of Elsin's reign -- the Aramon Spring, as some call it -- the eldest sons of any noteworthy House must serve in Geffion for a year and a day. This practice is intended to build character in aspiring lordlings, and provide a taste of leadership, experience and adventure to unite young men of quality in the comman goal of protecting our fair land -- or so it says in the Elsin's Charter.
zh: 在此宁静的背景之下，一项古老的传统被传承。自艾尔辛统治之初——人们称之为阿拉蒙之春——以来，任何显赫家族的长子都必须在盖菲翁服役一年一日。这一传统旨在培养有志成为领主的年轻贵族的品格，并让他们通过领导力、经验和冒险的体验，团结起来共同致力于保护我们的美好国土——正如《艾尔辛宪章》所述。

en: After receiving the crown of Aramon from the first Mage Emperor, Elsin was importuned by many noble houses to take up residence in their provinces. The new King would need a glorious city worthy of his office. Naturally, every house thought their lands to be the best and most appropriate choice for the new capitol of Aramon. The prestige and economic boon this represented was much desired by the nobles of the day, as was the opportunity to exert their influence on the young king.
zh: 在从第一位法师皇帝那里获得阿拉蒙王冠后，艾尔辛受到了许多贵族家族的请求，希望他能在他们的领地定居。新国王需要一座辉煌的城市来彰显其地位。自然而然，每个家族都认为自己的领地是最适合成为阿拉蒙新首都的选择。这种声望和经济利益对当时的贵族来说极具吸引力，同时他们也渴望影响这位年轻国王。

en: An annual summer event in Waleph is Fair-Day, a celebration that coincides with the summer solstice on the ancient Kandran calendar. The families of Waleph meet in the town center for a great feast, while bards and performers of all types meet to share stories and songs. However, Fair-Day's main events are horse races and other displays of riding ability. The proud young men who make up the city patrols train year-long for the contests; winners are awarded coin and other goods donated by the city families.
zh: 瓦尔菲普每年夏季都会举行名为‘集市日’的活动，庆祝与古代坎德兰历法中的夏至同步。瓦尔菲普的家族们会在镇中心聚会享用盛宴，而各类吟游诗人和表演者则会齐聚一堂分享故事与歌曲。然而，集市日的主要活动是赛马和其他展示骑术的表演。组成城市巡逻队的骄傲年轻男子们会为这些比赛进行一年的训练；获胜者将获得由城市家族捐赠的金币和其他物品。

en: After the long passage, the sight of land and the Verunan city of Vanoc sent a cheer through all three ships. Vanoc's younger folk rowed animal-skin outriggers to greet the ships, calling out to us in their peculiar, singsong accent. The island of Caora is truly Lihr's most beautiful work, with rocky cliffs giving way to beaches of black sand and tall graceful trees called marcas in the local dialect. My master and the rest of the party spent three full fortnights on the island, the first few days of which Horvino spent in a heady stupor from drinking prodigous quantities of moisina, a sweet drink made from marcas fruit juice and distilled spirits. My master is quite the trencherman, and is certainly developing a lordly belly!
zh: 经过漫长的航行，看到陆地和维鲁纳的城邦瓦诺克，让三艘船上的所有人都欢呼起来。瓦诺克的年轻居民们划着动物皮制成的独木舟前来迎接船只，用他们独特的唱腔向我们打招呼。卡奥拉岛确实是里尔最美丽的杰作，崎岖的悬崖逐渐过渡到黑色沙滩，以及高大优雅的被称为‘马卡斯’的树木。我的主人和其余的同伴在岛上停留了整整三周，其中前几天霍尔维诺因大量饮用莫西娜（一种由马卡斯果汁和蒸馏酒调制的甜饮料）而陷入沉醉状态。我的主人是个十足的饕餮，肯定正在长出贵族般的肚子！

en: It is said that Dinlow's Ferry was originally named Dinlow's Point, and that the area takes its name from a rather comical story originating in days long past. en: In developing their unprecedented Dynamic Battlefield Technology, the design team completely rewrote the meta-game rules, tapping their experience developing the Galactic War for Total Annihilation. Additional provisions include: Comprehensive algorithms for border influence modifiers between neighboring territories based on ownership; Intrinsic toughness levels for each territory; momentum factors based on recent victories; entrenchment bonuses for battles fought on territories after they've been conquered; and erosion and traffic modifiers that promise to make every battle fought count in a meaningful way, whether there are 500 or 5,000 people playing at any given time.
zh: 在开发其前所未有的动态战场技术时，设计团队彻底重写了元游戏规则，借鉴了他们在《银河战争》中为《横扫千军》开发的经验。其他补充规定包括：基于领土归属的邻近区域边境影响力调整综合算法；每个领土的固有韧性等级；基于近期胜利的动量因子；在已征服领土上战斗的据点加成；以及侵蚀和交通调整因子，确保无论同时在线人数是500还是5000，每一场战斗都具有实质意义。

en: The ritual, however, turns quite serious the next day, as the men gather again to settle the challenges from the previous day. Barechested and wielding wooden clubs -- no weapon of steel is allowed -- they pummel each other until one either submits or is rendered unconscious. The matches continue until one man left; he is named Thane of Gwillion for the next year, and his wooden club becomes the symbol of his office. The newly crowned Thane must then honor the losing combatants with a grand feast and many toasts (In contrast to the Calling Out, at this celebratory feast it is considered good etiquette to praise an opponent's strength and skill).
zh: 然而，仪式在第二天变得相当严肃，因为男人们再次聚集以解决前一天的挑战。他们赤裸上身，挥舞木制战斧——不允许使用钢铁武器——互相殴打，直到一方认输或失去意识。比赛持续进行，直到只剩一人；他将被命名为格威尔利恩氏族首领，他的木制战斧成为其职位的象征。新晋的氏族首领随后必须以盛大的宴会和许多敬酒来表彰失败的战士（与Calling Out不同，在这场庆祝宴会中，称赞对手的力量和技艺被视为良好的礼仪）。
